landing.heroSubtitle: Multi-branch inventory, VAT-compliant invoicing, and staff management — built specifically for used auto parts dealers.
landing.dailySalesTrendDesc: A healthier pace across your active locations.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to run a sharper operation
landing.featuresSubtitle: From branch coordination to invoicing and reporting, the platform is designed to support every part of the used auto parts business.

multiBranch.title: Multi-Branch Management
multiBranch.description: Switch between branches effortlessly, assign staff by location, and keep every outlet aligned with one shared system.

smartInvoicing.title: Smart Invoicing
smartInvoicing.description: Create VAT-compliant invoices, handle multi-item sales, and generate polished PDFs without leaving the workflow.

staffManagement.title: Staff Management

realTimeDashboard.title: Real-Time Dashboard
realTimeDashboard.description: Watch sales trends, inventory alerts, and branch performance from one live view that supports quick decisions.

landing.howItWorksTitle: From setup to daily selling in just three steps

step1.title: Add your branches and invite staff
step1.description: Set up each location, assign your team, and make sure everyone has the access they need from day one.

step2.title: Log donor vehicles and build your inventory
step2.description: Capture teardown details, create parts quickly, and grow your catalog with a consistent process.

step3.title: Sell, invoice, and track everything in one place
step3.description: Turn inventory into completed sales, issue invoices, and keep payments and balances under control.

landing.testimonialsTitle: Operations that feel more controlled and less chaotic

testimonial1.quote: The whole process feels faster now — from teardown to invoicing, everything stays in one place.

testimonial2.quote: We finally have one source of truth for branches, staff, and payments without jumping between tools.

testimonial3.quote: The invoicing flow alone saved us hours every week and made our reporting much cleaner.

landing.workflowTitle: A cleaner way to move from stock to sale
landing.workflowDesc: The dashboard keeps your team aligned with a simple path: log parts, manage branches, create invoices, and keep payments visible in one place.
landing.faqTitle: Questions that usually come up first

faq1.question: Is this built for multi-branch dealers?
faq1.answer: Yes. The platform is designed for teams that need branch-aware inventory, shared staff access, and clear reporting across locations.

faq2.question: Can I start with one branch and grow later?
faq2.answer: Absolutely. You can begin with a single branch and upgrade as your team and inventory expand.

faq3.question: Does it support VAT-compliant invoices?
faq3.answer: Yes. The invoicing flow supports VAT-ready documentation, multi-item sales, and downloadable invoice records.
